scope:
Full 1194-step single-GH200 #92-descendant adaptation; not certified #360.
Full CPU-resident 129.95GB ngram table, 8 serial logical ranks, full stage schedule,
upstream ANVIL/Adam/tail averaging, BOS training packing, 10,485,760-token validation.
Differences: padded ARM CUDA12 FA3; serial dense-gradient averaging; FP32 ngram
merge; FP8 delayed amax shared across microbatches; corrected descendant canon mask.

attention.modification: zero-pad unequal qk/v heads to same width; preserve explicit softmax scale; slice output to original v width

deviations: Descendant source, not certified record source; canonical mask follows corrected descendant
Padded stock ARM CUDA12 FA3; floating-point reduction order differs
Eight serial microbatches, explicit gradient averaging, shared delayed FP8 amax across logical ranks
FP32 ngram gradient aggregation then BF16 cast; not official FP16/local and BF16/distributed merge
CPU candidate/packing lookahead is one background thread; not original eight-rank pipeline
Evaluation compute reported separately and in full wall clock; not an official leaderboard timer
Final validation uses eager BF16 model, not the official compiled evaluation; intermediate rounding may differ.

timing_boundaries.training_loop: Includes real CPU packing/candidate lookahead, uploads, row service, complete forward/backward/update/tail ticks, syncs, logging, and first-update stall; excludes upfront compilation and final validation.
timing_boundaries.inner_step: Wall interval inside global-step body. Excludes some outer cycle work; GPU row pulls queued before the timer can still overlap this interval. Not a pure compute profiler.
timing_boundaries.validation: Data reading, hashing/pulling and actual full-size BF16 validation; no separate charge-and-repeat pull as in official leaderboard timer.
timing_boundaries.end_to_end: Launch shell through process teardown; includes startup, compilation, initial validation preflight, all training, finalization, final validation and cleanup.

prior_preflight_failure.cause: Initial TrainingManager schedule was not applied before preflight validation; fixed before the successful run.

limitations: Single seed, not statistical parity; loss slightly above nominal target.
Cold compiler-cache directory for this full harness, but Triton cache reused from pilots; not fully cold all-cache timing.
A first-update 41.95-second stall is included; cause not established by a profiler.
No full checkpoint saved; resuming requires model AND full ngram table/state, not model parameters alone.
Compiled-evaluation numerical equivalence is not verified; do not attribute the loss gap to the optimizer or CPU backing alone.
